cross_engine.coverage: 8 applications, one build each (cross-engine/commits.json). Page and view loads: Chromium 1187, Firefox 1187, WebKit 1187, at 7 widths, dark scheme, axe-core 4.14.1, Playwright 1.63.0 headless in a Linux container.
cross_engine.result: All 8 applications rendered every route or view they render in Chromium, with no engine-specific overflow or accessibility rule, except: Firefox on aguayluz-pr (/map blank) and ovnis-pr (the app falls to its error screen after the Map view), both because the map fails without WebGL; and WebKit on ovnis-pr, which surfaces a missing map worker that fails silently in Chromium. Every finding is in application map code; none is on a shared design-system element. Re-checked 2026-11-24 after the fixes merged: nothing beyond Chromium on either application (recheck).

findings.root_cause: /map renders nothing: the map library throws 'GPUInitializationError: WebGL2 is required' as an uncaught page error. This headless Firefox has no WebGL2; Chromium's software WebGL renders the map. The engine difference is this environment's, but the blank page is the application's handling of a missing WebGL2.

After the Map view, switching to any other view replaces the whole app with its error screen ('can't access property "destroy", this.painter is undefined'): the map could not create a WebGL context, map.remove() at dashboard/src/components/CaseMap.jsx:244 throws on unmount, and the only ErrorBoundary (App.jsx:22) wraps the navigation too. The view pass then could not reach 'Candidates' and 'More' at 320-768 px (8 view loads). Reproduced by hand in Firefox; not reproduced in Chromium or WebKit.

SyntaxError: Unexpected token '<' on 7 view loads: the build has no maplibre-gl-worker.mjs, so /assets/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs is answered with the SPA's index.html. Chromium requests the same file, gets the same HTML and fails silently (reproduced by hand), so this is a build defect present in every engine that only WebKit reports.

cross_engine.not_findings: Firefox reported fewer link-in-text-block page loads than Chromium on skywatcher-pr (13 -> 0) and aguayluz-pr (14 -> 7). Fewer is not evidence of a fix; axe's evaluation of that rule depends on computed styles that differ by engine.
cross_engine.limits: WebKit here is Playwright's Linux WebKit build, not Safari on macOS or iOS. Firefox here has no WebGL2. Pages and views were loaded or opened, not operated. aguayluz-pr and centinelas-pr were installed with the pydantic-core pin removed from constraints-desktop.txt, because the pinned set does not resolve (see below).

recheck.coverage: Same method and versions as the first pass (Chromium 157, Firefox 155, WebKit 26.6, 7 widths, axe-core 4.14.1). Page or view loads: Chromium 172, Firefox 172, WebKit 172. Both apps installed from their own pins, without the pydantic-core workaround the first pass needed.
recheck.result: Neither application shows anything beyond Chromium in Firefox or WebKit: every route and view rendered, no page errors, no view-switch errors.

findings_resolved.observed: /map renders at all seven widths (3300-3702 characters; 0 before) with no page errors.
All six views open at all widths; 0 view-switch errors (8 before).
No page errors (7 before); /assets/maplibre-gl-worker-*.js now answers 200 text/javascript (text/html before).

cross_engine.state_scope: For the builds recorded: the first-pass commits of six applications (cross-engine/commits.json) and the rechecked mains of aguayluz-pr and ovnis-pr. A later commit of any application is not covered.

desktop_setup_pin_conflict.statement: constraints-desktop.txt pins pydantic==2.13.5 with pydantic-core==2.48.0. pydantic 2.13.5 requires pydantic-core==2.46.5, so `python3 desktop/setup.py` fails with ResolutionImpossible ('Cannot install fastapi'). This holds for aguayluz-pr at c60587e and for centinelas-pr at d96863d and on current main (pin since d55eb47). thehub-pr and spiderweb-pr pin the consistent pair 2.13.4 / 2.46.4.
desktop_setup_pin_conflict.effect: A fresh desktop setup of either application cannot complete; its .app launcher shows 'First-run setup could not finish'.
